remarks: Discover a Rare Opportunity to own this large 3-bedroom, 2-bath residence nestled in the vibrant heart of downtown Greenwich. Located within the coveted Putnam Park, this newly renovated two-story unit offers a unique blend of style, comfort, and convenience, making it perfect for those who lead busy, active lifestyles. As you enter, you're immediately captivated by the expansive open floor plan that creates a seamless flow throughout the living space. Gleaming hardwood floors add warmth and sophistication, making it an ideal setting for entertaining friends and family. Natural light pours in through large windows, illuminating the interior and showcasing picturesque views of the meticulously manicured grounds. At the heart of this home lies the beautifully renovated kitchen, designed with an open layout that encourages social interaction and effortless entertaining. Outfitted with stainless steel appliances, generous counter space, and abundant storage, it's a culinary haven that masterfully blends modern elegance with practicality. The residence features a fully gutted and exquisitely renovated master bathroom, that showcases high-end finishes and thoughtful design. Complementing this luxury is a brand new walk-in closet, offering ample space and organization for your wardrobe, elevating your everyday living experience. Step onto the balcony and immerse yourself in the serene, park-like views, providing the perfect escape for unwinding after a busy day.
